questions.question: After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively? × and +, 3 and 9 I. 7 × 9 – 8 ÷ 2 + 3 II. 4 × 9 – 3 + 8 ÷ 2
questions.questionHtml:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively? 

× and +, 3 and 9

I. 7 × 9 – 8 ÷ 2 + 3

II. 4 × 9 – 3 + 8 ÷ 2
questions.solution:
According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and two numbers i.e :

  • × and +
  • Two numbers 3 and 9

So,

I. 7 + 3 – 8 ÷ 2 × 9

⇒ 7 + 3 - 4 × 9

⇒ 7 + 3 - 36

⇒ 10 - 36

⇒ -26

II. 4 + 3 – 9 × 8 ÷ 2

⇒ 4 + 3 - 9 × 4

⇒ 4 + 3 - 36

⇒ 7 - 36

⇒ -29

Here, values of equation (I) and (II)  are (-26) and (-29) respectively.

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.

questions.solution:
Given : 21 * 4 * 156 * 13 * 11 = 83

According to the question, after replacing the * signs:

So,

  • Option - (1) : −, ÷, ×, +

21 + 0.02 - 13 × 11 = 83

21 + 0.02 - 143 = 83

21.02 - 143 = 83

- 121.98 ≠ 83 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: All cards are boxes. All boxes are torches. All torches are shoes. Conclusions: I. All shoes are torches. II. All torches are boxes. III. All boxes are cards. IV. All cards are shoes.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All cards are boxes.

All boxes are torches.

All torches are shoes.

Conclusions:

I. All shoes are torches.

II. All torches are boxes.

III. All boxes are cards.

IV. All cards are shoes.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
options.html: Only conclusions II and III follow

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
options.html: Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
I. All shoes are torches → Does not follow (As all torches are shoes. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. All torches are boxes → Does not follow (As all boxes are torches. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

III. All boxes are cards → Does not follow (As all cards are boxes. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

IV. All cards are shoes → Follow (As all cards are boxes, all boxes are torches and all torches are shoes. So, it is definitely true)

questions.question: The term ‘Back-stick’ is used in which of the following games/sports?
questions.questionHtml: The term ‘Back-stick’ is used in which of the following games/sports?
questions.solution: Back-stick is a type of foul in the game of hockey. It is awarded against a player who strikes the ball with the rounded back of the hockey stick. Other types of fouls in hockey include obstruction, advancing, hockey stick interference, and undercutting. Hockey players can only hit the ball with the flat side of their stick. Therefore, hitting the ball using the flat side of the stick is not considered a type of foul in the game of hockey.

questions.solution: Baisakhi is a spring harvest festival celebrated with great enthusiasm in Punjab, Haryana and Chandigarh. It also commemorates the formation of Khalsa Panth by Guru Gobind Singh in 1699. Lohri is a bonfire harvest festival celebrated in January, Hola Mohalla is a three-day long Sikh festival that usually falls in spring and Teej is a grand festival of Rajasthan celebrating the spirit of womanhood.

questions.question: Chemical formula of quick lime is ______.
questions.questionHtml: Chemical formula of quick lime is ______.
questions.solution: The chemical formula for quick lime is CaO. Quicklime is also known as burnt lime or calcium oxide. It reacts with water to form calcium hydroxide and with carbon dioxide to form calcium carbonate. Quicklime is used in the production of cement, as well as in the Basic Oxygen Steelmaking process and in the production of glass, calcium aluminate cement, and organic chemicals.

questions.question: What is the unit of work done?
questions.questionHtml: What is the unit of work done?
questions.solution: Work done is the product of force and distance moved. The unit of work done is Joule, which is the S.I. unit of energy and work. One Joule is equal to the work done when a force of one Newton is applied over a distance of one meter. It is important to note that Watt is the S.I. unit of power, Ampere is the S.I. unit of current, and Decibel is a unit of intensity of sound.

questions.question: The Ramakrishna Mission stressed the ideal of __________ through social service and selfless action.
questions.questionHtml: The Ramakrishna Mission stressed the ideal of __________ through social service and selfless action.
questions.solution: The Ramakrishna Mission emphasized the ideal of salvation through social service and selfless action. Inspired by Ramakrishna Paramahamsa and led by Swami Vivekananda, it follows the principles of karma yoga and promotes welfare alongside spiritual advancement. questions.question: International Non-Violence Day is observed on_____.

questions.solution: International Non-Violence Day is observed on 2 October in honor of the birthday of Mahatma Gandhi. This global observance promotes non-violence through education and public awareness. questions.question: Which of the following Dynasties established the kingdom of Vijayanagara?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following Dynasties established the kingdom of Vijayanagara?
questions.solution: The Sangama dynasty established the kingdom of Vijayanagara in 1336. Harihara and Bukka, the founders of the dynasty, founded the city of Vijayanagara on the south bank of the Tungabhadra river. The dynasty ruled from 1336-1485, and Deva Raya II was the most famous ruler of this dynasty. Other dynasties that ruled Vijayanagara include the Saluva, Tuluva, and Aravidu dynasties.

It was headquartered at New Delhi's Safdarjung Airport and primarily served the Northeastern part of India. The airline was set up to operate as a regional airline to improve air connectivity in the region. Therefore, the correct answer is 1981.

questions.question: Wearing away of landscape by different agents like water, wind and ice is called ______.
questions.questionHtml: Wearing away of landscape by different agents like water, wind and ice is called ______.
questions.solution: Erosion is the wearing away of the landscape by different agents like water, wind, and ice. It is a slow and continuous process that shapes the ground surface over time. Accelerated erosion is caused by human activities like destroying natural vegetation or altering the contour of the ground without providing surface protection. Weathering, on the other hand, is the breaking down or dissolving of rocks and minerals on the surface of the earth due to physical processes like changes in temperature and exposure to wind, rain, and waves. Therefore, the correct answer is erosion.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the methods of national income estimation?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is NOT one of the methods of national income estimation?
questions.solution: National income can be estimated through three methods: Income, Production, and Expenditure. Income method measures payments made to primary factors, Production method measures value-added by firms, and Expenditure method estimates national income through private and govt expenditure. Banking method is not a method of national income estimation.

questions.question: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded a reform association known as Brahmo Sabha which was later known as ______.
questions.questionHtml: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded a reform association known as Brahmo Sabha which was later known as ______.
questions.solution: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded the Brahmo Sabha which later became known as the Brahmo Samaj. Established in 1828, it aimed to purify Hinduism and teach monotheism, relying on the twin pillars of reason and Vedas and Upanishads. The conflict between Keshab Chandra Sen and Debendranath Tagore broadened in 1865 when Tagore allowed the Brahmos conducting services to wear their sacred threads, leading Keshab to withdraw and establish the Brahmo Samaj of India on 15th November 1866. The Brahmo Samaj played a significant role in the Indian renaissance and the freedom movement.

questions.solution: Xylem parenchyma. Xylem tissue in plants transports water, nutrients, and other dissolved minerals from roots to other parts of the plant while also providing mechanical strength. Tracheids and vessels are the conducting elements, and xylem fibers provide strength. Xylem parenchyma cells store carbohydrates, fats, and water.

questions.question: In which of the following Indian states, Harappan cities have NOT been found?
questions.questionHtml: In which of the following Indian states, Harappan cities have NOT been found?
questions.solution: Harappan cities were found in Punjab, Sind, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Haryana but not in Uttarakhand. The civilization thrived from 2600 BC to 1900 BC and vanished around 1400 BC. These cities were unique for their objects like red pottery, stone weights, seals, special beads, copper tools, and paralleled sided long stone blades. They were also divided into Citadel and lower town.

questions.question: In a 1500 m race, Anil beats Bakul by 150 m and in the same race Bakul beats Charles by 75 m. By what distance does Anil beat Charles?
questions.questionHtml: In a 1500 m race, Anil beats Bakul by 150 m and in the same race Bakul beats Charles by 75 m. By what distance does Anil beat Charles?
questions.solution:
When Anil completes the race, Bakul covered (1500 - 150) = 1350 m

In a 1500 m race Charles is 75 m behind Bakul

So, in 1350 m race Charles is 75/1500 × 1350 = 67.5 m behind Bakul

So, Charles is (67.5 + 150) = 217.5 m behind from Anil in 1500 m race

Anil beat Charlie by 217.50 m.

questions.question: The batting average for 27 innings of a cricket player is 47 runs. His highest score in an innings exceeds his lowest score by 157 runs. If these two innings are excluded, the average score of the remaining 25 innings is 42 runs. Find his highest score in an innings.
questions.questionHtml: The batting average for 27 innings of a cricket player is 47 runs. His highest score in an innings exceeds his lowest score by 157 runs. If these two innings are excluded, the average score of the remaining 25 innings is 42 runs. Find his highest score in an innings.
questions.solution:
The batting average for 27 innings is 47 runs and for 25 innings is 42 runs (High and Low scores excluded)

Here, the Average decreases by (47 - 42) = 5 

So, Total runs in that two innings (H + L) = 47 + 47 + (25 × 5) = 219 runs

Difference of runs in that two innings (H - L) = 157 runs

So, 2H = 219 + 157 ⇒ H = 376/2 = 188 runs

questions.question: P and Q can complete a project in 15 days and 10 days, respectively. They started doing the work together, but after 2 days, Q had to leave and P alone completed the remaining work. In how many days was the whole work completed?
questions.questionHtml: P and Q can complete a project in 15 days and 10 days, respectively. They started doing the work together, but after 2 days, Q had to leave and P alone completed the remaining work. In how many days was the whole work completed?
questions.solution:
LCM of 15, 10 is 30 (total work)

Efficiency of P = 30/15 = 2 and efficiency of Q = 30/10 = 3

In 2 days they together completed (3 + 2) × 2 = 10 and remaining = 20

As Q left remaining work will be done by P = 20/2 = 10 days

Total work done in 10 + 2 = 12 days

questions.question: If \(x^{2} - 5x + 1 = 0,\) then the value of \(\frac{x^{6}+x^{4}+x^{2}+1}{5x^{3}}=?\)
questions.questionHtml: If \(x^{2} - 5x + 1 = 0,\) then the value of \(\frac{x^{6}+x^{4}+x^{2}+1}{5x^{3}}=?\)
questions.solution:
If a + 1/a = b, then, a3 + 1/a3 = b3 - 3b

⇒ x2 - 5x + 1 = 0  ⇒ x2 + 1 = 5x  ⇒ x + 1/x = 5 

\(\frac{x^{6}+x^{4}+x^{2}+1}{5x^{3}}\)  ⇒ \(\frac{x^{3}+x+\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{x^3}}{5}\)  

⇒ \(\frac{5^3 -3\times5+5}{5}\)  ⇒ \(\frac{125 - 15 +5}{5}\) ⇒ \(\frac{115}{5}\)  ⇒ 23

questions.question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence. She said, “I am in no mood to work now.”
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

She said, “I am in no mood to work now.”

options.text: She said that she has been in no mood to work then.
options.html: She said that she has been in no mood to work then.

options.text: She said that she was in no mood to work now.
options.html: She said that she was in no mood to work now.

options.text: She said that she was in no mood to work then.
options.html: She said that she was in no mood to work then.

options.text: She said that she has been in no mood to work now.
options.html: She said that she has been in no mood to work now.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is She said that she was in no mood to work then.

Key Points

  • In the original sentence, "She said, 'I am in no mood to work now,'" the verb is in the present tense ("am") and the time reference is the present ("now").

  • When converting this to indirect speech:

    • The pronoun "I" changes to "she" to match the subject of the sentence.

    • The verb tense changes, or "backshifts," from the present tense ("am") to the past tense ("was").

    • This reflects that the reported speech happened in the past.

    • The time reference changes from "now" to "then" to show that the time of the reported speech is different from the time the words were originally spoken.

    • Hence, the correct answer will be Option 3, "She said that she was in no mood to work then."

questions.question: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence. Manu will tell her later.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Manu will tell her later.

options.text: She will be tell later by Manu
options.html: She will be tell later by Manu

options.text: She will tell later by Manu.
options.html: She will tell later by Manu.

options.text: She will be told later by Manu.
options.html: She will be told later by Manu.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is She will be told later by Manu. 

Key Points

  • In the passive voice of simple future tense, the auxiliary verb shall / will is used with be and past participle of a verb.
  • The object of the sentence becomes the subject.
  • Here action will be done on the object in the future.
  • Formation:
    • Active: Subject + will/shall + V1 + object.
    • Passive: Object + will/shall + be + V3 + by + subject.
  • Thus, the correct passive form of the given sentence is option 3.

questions.question: Select the correct active form of the given sentence. Has the villa been occupied by them?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

Has the villa been occupied by them?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Have they occupied the villa?

Key Points

  • The given sentence is in the present perfect tense.
  • In the present perfect tense passive verb forms are made by putting has/have + been before the past participle form of the verb.
  • For converting passive to active voice the places of subject and object are inter-changed and by is removed.
  • Sentence structure:
    • Active voice: Subject + has/have + past participle (V3) + object
    • Passive voice: Object + has/have + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject)
  • Thus, the correct active form of the given sentence is option 3.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Confusion
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Confusion
questions.solution:
The correct answer is commotion.

Key Points

  • Confusion: the state of not being able to think clearly or not understanding something. (स्पष्ट रूप से सोचने में सक्षम न होने या कुछ न समझ पाने की अवस्था)
    • For e.g.- There is still some confusion as to the time of the meeting
  • Commotion: A state of confused and noisy disturbance. (भ्रमित और शोरगुल की स्थिति) 
    • For e.g.- His arrival caused quite a commotion.
  • The most appropriate synonym of the given word is option 4. 

Additional Information

  • Intrepidity: The quality of being intrepid; bravery. निर्भयता
  • Stagnation: Stability. स्थिरता
  • Perusal: a reading or examining of something. ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ने की क्रिया; अवलोकन

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of adverb of manner.

options.text: He has just done his work.

options.html: He has done his work on my table.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is He does his work carefully.

Key Points

  • An adverb of manner modifies or changes a sentence to tell us how something happens, such as whether it was quickly or slowly.
  • They're usually placed after the main verb or after the object.
  • Here, carefully is used to qualify the verb do.
  • Carefully is used as an adverb of manner.
  • Thus, the sentence with the appropriate use of adverb of manner is option 3.

Key Points

  • Force:  something powerful that drives or propels change.
  • All other given options do not show any parallelism with the given context.
  • Thus, the correct option is option 4. 

Additional Information

  • Impact: an effect or impression. परिणाम या प्रभाव
  • Might: used for saying that something is possible. किसी बात की ‘संभावना’ का अर्थ व्‍यक्त करने के लिए प्रयुक्त
  • Factors: things that influences a decision, situation, etc. किसी निर्णय, स्थिति आदि को प्रभावित करने वाला तत्‍व; कारक

Confusion Points

  • In the given question, 'force' is a singular noun, which fits well with the singular verb 'can be'.
  • 'Force' here refers to an impetus or a driving power, and it gives the sentence a strong, decisive sense of direction.
  • The use of 'factors' is incorrect grammatically because 'factors' is a plural noun.
  • Using a plural noun ('factors') after 'the prime' (which expects a singular noun) and with the singular verb 'can be' would be incorrect.
  • The construction 'the prime factors' suggests that there are several most important factors, but the verb 'can be' implies there is one thing (Digital India) that fills this role.
